tutorials.title: Hello world! A simple fitting on a 1D traveling wave
tutorials.concepts: Configure NIF, train, save and restore weights, refine with L-BFGS.
goals: Learn the `nif.NIF` model, its configuration, and training loop.
Save and restore checkpoints; refine the fit with L-BFGS.

tutorials.title: Tackling multi-scale data
tutorials.concepts: Use NIFMultiScale to represent high-frequency spatial structure.
goals: Use `nif.NIFMultiScale` and compare fits to a high-frequency wave.

tutorials.title: Learning a linear representation
tutorials.case: Cylinder-flow data from an adaptive mesh
tutorials.concepts: Use NIFMultiScaleLastLayerParameterized to learn linear spatial bases.
goals: Use `nif.NIFMultiScaleLastLayerParameterized` on a cylinder-flow dataset from an adaptive mesh.

tutorials.title: Getting input-output derivatives
tutorials.concepts: Wrap a field model with JacobianLayer and HessianLayer.

tutorials.title: Large-scale data training
tutorials.concepts: Create shards and stream batches from a one-million-row dataset.
goals: Create and stream record shards using `nif.data.tfr_dataset.TFRDataset`.
Train on batches from a one-million-row example dataset.

tutorials.title: Revisit multi-scale data with regularization
tutorials.concepts: Penalize ParameterNet parameters and inspect a refined evaluation grid.
goals: Compare L1 and L2 regularization of ParameterNet weights and biases.
Inspect training fits and spurious signals on a refined space-time grid.

tutorials.title: NIF compression
tutorials.concepts: Magnitude pruning, dynamic int8 CPU inference, and inference export.
goals: Explore magnitude pruning, dynamic int8 quantization, and exported inference.

tutorials.title: Revisit multi-scale data with Sobolev training
tutorials.case: Sobolev training of a multiscale field
tutorials.concepts: Supervise spatial derivatives and evaluate field and derivative errors.
goals: Add spatial-derivative supervision with `nif.layers.JacobianLayer` and compare field and derivative errors.
Inspect how derivative information affects the refined spatial prediction.

tutorials.title: Experimental: self-scaled optimizer comparison
tutorials.concepts: Compare three quasi-Newton implementations, physical absolute errors and timing.
goals: Compare L-BFGS, SSBFGS and SSBroyden from one actual traveling-wave checkpoint in float64.
Run all three methods and inspect physical errors, convergence curves and elapsed time. See the [experimental guide](docs/SELF_SCALED_OPTIMIZERS.md) for the recorded results and scope.
